name: Joshi Ryou Ecchi♪  ~xxx Shimasu kara Ryouhi Kudasai!~
original_name: 女子寮えっち♪  ～×××しますから寮費ください！～
source:
Main character receives invitation from his uncle to work part-time in the dormitory during summer vacations. He only needs to collect fees from the inhabitant girls, so he becomes the most influential person in the whole building...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Cancelled [url=http://www.lilith-soft.com/lilith/product06.html]VN[/url] which was later released as part of "2005 Kamihanki Lilith Best Selection with Joshi Ryou Ecchi"
